{{Otheruses|Ship}}
[[File:sailboataway.jpg|thumb|A boat on Drexel]]
'''Boats''', also known as '''ships''', were utilized for [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] or maritime duties by both civilians and military units. They were made out of wood or metal, depending on the [[Time/Legends|era]] or purpose. As such, some destroyed ships had their remains sink to the bottom of the body of water. While many in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] needed to travel between the [[Star/Legends|stars]], those living solely in one place on their home [[Planet/Legends|planets]] required less sophisticated varieties of transport.

==History==
The boats of [[Somov Rit]] varied in size, but seemed to follow similar, simple designs. The people of Somov Rit used long poles to push the boats through the marshy [[Water/Legends|waters]]. The elder Governor [[Quarg]] of [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]] exiled a number of [[Technician/Legends|technos]] on the boat to be left adrift, thinking they would perish at sea; instead, they became the first [[Dragon Lords]]. On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], both [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the Human colonists developed a variety of sophisticated aquatic vehicles. Nevertheless, simple fishing rigs were still used by the [[Fisher/Legends|fishermen]], such as ones in the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Simple wind-blown boats and canoes were also used by people of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], as well as [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].

The fishermen of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] colony [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]] used steam-driven wooden seafaring vessels to catch [[Fish/Legends|fish]] in the planet's deep [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook, Second Edition">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the self-styled [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Quarg]] and his [[ship-dweller]]s lived in the [[Great Ship]], a reconverted aquatic vessel that served as a floating habitat.
